items:
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction 
 valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.
Cleaning fluid, manual puller.
Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Vibrometer, straight edge.
Rags.

Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn-out components.

Check alignment and compare 
 it with the setting value.

Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do 
 (if it is needed).

Check discharge pressure and compare it with 
 the setting value then replace the worn-out components (if it is needed).

Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it (if it 
 is needed).

Make test for bearings oil and add or change 
 it (if it is needed).

Check glands for leaking and replace it if it 
 is needed.
Check flanges for leaking.

Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint (if it is needed).

 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, 
 to be carried out every six months as indicated by M6 in the above title 
 block.
This pump is a vertical diagonal pump with 
 swiveling of the impeller blade, its function to condensate the steam 
 of turbine in condenser.
Technical 
 specification
Type of 
 pump | Sigma 1000 
 BQDV 1290 36 LU 00
Design | Vertical mixed flow 
 regulating pump in wet sump
Liquid 
 temperature max | 30 C
Pump 
 capacity | 12844.8 m3/h ( 3568 l/s )
Specific 
 energy | 19 m w.c. ( 186 j/kg )
Speed of 
 pump | 496 rpm.
Efficiency | 80%
Weight of 
 pump | 9800 
 kg/pc
Torque 
 moment | 17360 Nm
Bearing Type | 29456 
 6056MB
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Medhat 
 Fouad, reviewed by eng. Mohammed Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil, and approved 
 by eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab; Head Sector of Talkha PS 2x210MW.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El 
 Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, 
 and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection 
 & quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
 control head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment.
Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction 
 valves.
Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs etc.
Cleaning fluid, manual puller.
Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Vibrometer, straight edge.
Rags.
Work to be carried out
Pump In Operation
Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do.
Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 compare them with the setting value then replace the worn-out components.
Pump Out Of 
Operation
Check alignment and compare 
 it with the setting value.
Measure vibrations level for bearings and 
 compare it with the setting value, then analyze it and determine what to do 
 (if it is needed).
Check discharge pressure and compare it with 
 the setting value then replace the worn-out components (if it is needed).
Check bolts fixation, then re-tight it (if it 
 is needed).
Make test for bearings oil and add or change 
 it (if it is needed).
Check glands for leaking and replace it if it 
 is needed.
Check flanges for leaking.
Check the pump casing against rust and 
 re-paint (if it is needed).
